# no-hard-tabs

- ID: `MD010`
- Category: Whitespace and layout
- Default: on, severity warning
- Fixable: yes
- Tags: `whitespace`, `hard_tab`

Lines contain no tab characters, including inside code.

## Why

Editors and tools show tabs at different widths, such as 4 or 8 spaces, so text
aligned with tabs lines up differently in different tools.

## Options

Set them under `rules.no-hard-tabs.options`.

- `code_blocks` (`boolean`, default `true`): Check code blocks and code spans
  too.
- `ignore_code_languages` (`string[]`, default `[]`): Languages of fenced code
  blocks to skip, matched against the first word of the info string in any case.
  When it names any language, fences that name none are skipped too.
- `spaces_per_tab` (`integer`, default `1`): Spaces that replace each tab in a
  fix.

## Fix

The fix replaces each tab with spaces. gomdlint reports some tabs without a fix,
such as tabs inside code, where replacing them would change the code. gomdlint
may report a finding without a fix when the fix would change a line with one
character in brackets, such as \[x\] or \[1\], or the lines around it up to a
blank line, because it could add or remove a task list checkbox. In a document
with raw HTML other than comments and plain br, wbr, hr or img tags, gomdlint
reports every finding without a fix.

## Configure

```yaml
rules:
  no-hard-tabs:
    options:
      code_blocks: true
```

Under `rules`, `no-hard-tabs: false` turns the rule off and
`no-hard-tabs: error` reports its findings as errors. The flag
`--disable no-hard-tabs` turns it off for one run.

## Silence one line

```markdown
<!-- markdownlint-disable-next-line no-hard-tabs -->
```
